input: Plan a surprise baby shower for Sara

gold.taskTitle: Plan a Surprise Baby Shower for Sara
gold.taskDescription: Organize all the details needed to throw a surprise baby shower for Sara.

questions.title: When is Sara's baby due date?
questions.description: Understanding the due date helps determine the ideal timing for the shower.

questions.title: How many guests are you planning to invite?
questions.description: Guest count shapes the venue size, catering quantities, and overall budget.

questions.title: Do you have a budget range in mind?
questions.description: A defined budget guides decisions on venue, food, decorations, and activities.

questions.title: Will the shower be at a home or rented venue?
questions.description: The location type affects logistics, setup, catering options, and cost.

questions.title: Is there a theme or color scheme you want?
questions.description: A theme ties together decorations, invitations, cake, and party favors cohesively.

questions.title: Who else is helping you organize this event?
questions.description: Knowing co-hosts or helpers clarifies how to divide planning responsibilities.

questions.title: What does Sara's gift registry or wishlist look like?
questions.description: Registry details help guide guests on appropriate and useful gifts for Sara.
